fact: The article says Tanzania recently launched a National Cybersecurity Strategy (2023-2028); no launch date is given, so as_of is the document's published date.

The article says the Tanzania Computer Emergency Response Team (TZ-CERT) reports a steady increase in cyber incidents in the country, so it exists and operates; as_of is the document's published date.
The Minister states Tanzania, through TCRA, established TZ-CERT under the Electronic and Postal Communications Act, 2010, and that it monitors, detects and responds to cybersecurity threats.

Government Notice No. 147 of 19 June 2026, made by the Minister for Communication and Information Technology under section 28 of the Cybercrimes Act (Cap. 443), designates 25 categories of computer systems as critical information infrastructure and requires owners to register them with the Ministry and submit quarterly risk assessments.
